name: EquipDash Bookings
author: equipdash

sections.description:
EquipDash runs bookings for rental shops, tour and activity operators, classes and lessons. This plugin puts your EquipDash booking page on your own WordPress site, so customers book without leaving it.

  • The EquipDash block: add your booking page, one item with its calendar, a collection, or a Book now button to any page.
  • A Book now button on every page: one switch in Settings > EquipDash.
  • Shortcodes for the classic editor, Divi and other page builders.
  • An Elementor widget.

Prices, availability, payments and bookings stay in EquipDash, so nothing is double-booked and nothing needs setting up twice.

You need an EquipDash account. Start a free trial.

External services

This plugin connects to EquipDash (https://equipdash.com) to show your booking page. When you connect, your site address is sent to EquipDash. On pages that show bookings, your visitors’ browsers load the booking page and a script from app.equipdash.com. Terms and privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings > EquipDash and click Connect EquipDash. Sign in and pick your business.
  3. Edit any page and add the EquipDash block.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce?

No. Checkout happens in EquipDash.

Does it slow my site down?

The booking page loads only on pages that show it, and only after the rest of the page.

Which shortcodes are there?

[equipdash module=”rentals”], [equipdash_item type="rental" id="12" style="calendar"], [equipdash_collection id="summer-picks"], [equipdash_button label="Book now"].
